INSERT INTO nginx_ua_stat ( source_id, bucket_time, user_agent, request_count, sum_request_time_ms, max_request_time_ms, slow_count, status_5xx, create_time ) VALUES
(#{r.sourceId}, #{r.bucketTime}, #{r.userAgent}, #{r.requestCount}, #{r.sumRequestTimeMs}, #{r.maxRequestTimeMs}, #{r.slowCount}, #{r.status5xx}, #{r.createTime})

INSERT INTO nginx_referer_stat ( source_id, bucket_time, referer, request_count, sum_request_time_ms, max_request_time_ms, slow_count, status_5xx, create_time ) VALUES
(#{r.sourceId}, #{r.bucketTime}, #{r.referer}, #{r.requestCount}, #{r.sumRequestTimeMs}, #{r.maxRequestTimeMs}, #{r.slowCount}, #{r.status5xx}, #{r.createTime})

INSERT INTO nginx_request_sample ( source_id, ts, client_ip, uri, method, request_time_ms, upstream_time_ms, status, user_agent, referer, create_time ) VALUES
